sara (oncall): :rotating_light: Observed large spike in inference tail latency (p95 > 2s) in us-west. Customers hitting timeouts. Paging now.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-17T21:47:12Z created — active pages sent to @oncall. Impact: high latency, partial error spikes. Runbook: https://intra/runbooks/inference-latency
james (eng-sre): On it — looking at autoscaler logs and GPU queue depth. Can you post the affected service and a quick sample trace id?
sara (oncall): service: inference-api-v2. Sample trace: trace-0a1b2c3d. I see request queue depth climb to ~120, GPU util ~95%.
molly (observability): Adding realtime panel for queue depth + p95 while we triage. Quick PromQL I used:```
sum(rate(inference_request_count[1m])) by (instance)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
molly (observability): Also suggest muting noisy alert `InferenceHighTailLatency` temporarily to reduce noise while we investigate. We should not lose the incident signal though.
james (eng-sre): Agreed mute for 10m while we stabilize, but create a separate monitor to track absolute request failures. I'll flip canary fallback to smaller batch sizes to reduce KV cache pressure.
sara (oncall): Flipped fallback -> batch_size=4 on us-west nodes. Request latency is improving to p95 ~1.2s.
leen (product): Do we have a customer impact count? Any payments or large tenants affected so we need CS notified?
sara (oncall): ~18 requests/min failing at peak across 6 tenant IDs. Biggest affected tenant: AcmeCo (10 errors/min). Alex, can you draft a short note for CS?
alex (support): on it, will post a status note in #support-outage in 10m.
molly (observability): For post-incident: propose a small dashboard focused on golden signals for inference: p95 latency, error rate, request rate, GPU utilization, queue depth, kv-cache hit ratio. Add drilldowns to traces and runbook. I'll sketch panels now.
molly (observability): Panel queries I'm planning to add:```
# p95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))

# error rate
sum(rate(inference_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_request_count[5m]))

# queue depth
avg(inference_request_queue_depth) by (region)

# kvcache hit ratio
sum(inference_kv_cache_hits) / sum(inference_kv_cache_requests)
```
james (eng-sre): Nice. Also add a panel for "fallbacks triggered" and a small table listing current autoscaler pods + queue length. That will speed on-call triage.
molly (observability): Will do. Plan: create dashboard PR with JSON panels + drilldown links to traces and the runbook. Template for drilldown: `https://intra/traces/{{trace_id}}` and runbook link pinned to top.
sara (oncall): After the batch-size fallback we saw error rate drop 70% in 6m. Marking mitigation as successful.
james (eng-sre): For alert tuning: lower sensitivity on transient p95 blips <5m and add a sustained window (10m) threshold. New alert proposal: p95(latency) > 1.5s for 10m AND error_rate > 1% for 5m. That should reduce noise but keep actionable.
molly (observability): I'll add draft rule to the alerts repo and reference it in the dashboard PR. Also will include a notebook with before/after alert noise stats (pager count per week).
leen (product): Thanks — can we include a small customer-impact widget (top affected tenants) on the dashboard? helps product and CS triage.
molly (observability): Yep — adding a table panel: top 10 tenants by error rate with links to tenant runbooks.
ames (eng-sre): :thumbsup: (typo on previous msg, meant james)
james (eng-sre): Opening follow-up checklist: 1) dashboard PR (#432) 2) alert rule PR (#433) 3) runbook update for batch fallbacks 4) postmortem notes w/ customer impact numbers. Assigning owners and due EOD tomorrow.
sara (oncall): Leaving handoff: handing to night oncall @james in 15m. Please monitor and unmute alert if regression.
james (eng-sre): Acknowledged — I'll watch and escalate if anything pops. Thanks all. :heart:
